rule: Main figures: 7 per series. Supplements: not fixed, about 2 to 3 times the main count. A figure's status comes from its dependencies, not from intent. No figure shows a result before the checklist item that produces it has closed. Omission figures 02 to 07 are owner-TBD and show no omission outcome before blind omission (AGENTS.md firewall). Citations are UNSET until verified against the papers.
authority: owner, chat 2026-11-06 (main figure scope); supplements and statuses proposed by the builder
owner_questions: Citations to verify: Mendoza-Halliday et al. (spectrolaminar motif), the Major et al. reply, the Caminos model, Disney (SST-CB and CR-VIP overlap), Campagnola et al. 2022 (mouse V1 connection probabilities). Titles and years are UNSET until read.
Figure 01 reward feedback: the paradigm spec lists reward schedule as an unresolved field; draw it marked unresolved or supply the timing.
Source of the omission project's paradigm figure: path in the omission repository (omission-mac).

figures.title: Spectrolaminar motif: concept, oscillations, LFP, ubiquity
figures.content: The motif (gamma superficial, alpha-beta deep, L4 crossover), how LFP and relative power by depth express oscillations, and how widely the motif occurs across areas and species. Sources: Mendoza-Halliday et al. and the Major et al. reply.
figures.data_needed: observed relative-power maps (not in the repository)

figures.title: Oscillation mechanisms I: network
figures.content: Synfire chain, PING, PINB, sparse random connectivity, E-I loops: schematic of each and the frequency it predicts. Proposed split with figure 03: network-level mechanisms here.
figures.data_needed: none (schematics); optional isolated-module traces from item 11

figures.title: Oscillation mechanisms II: cellular and laminar
figures.content: Subthreshold oscillations, membrane time constant, and the Caminos model: how single-cell timescales set preferred frequency. Proposed split with figure 02.
figures.data_needed: none (schematics); rheobase and time-constant table from item 6

figures.title: Observed microcircuit and type mapping
figures.content: Mapping PV/E/CB/CR to PV/E/SST/VIP, with the CB~SST and CR~VIP overlap reported by Disney and colleagues stated as an assumption with its uncertainty; the resulting SST/PV ratio by depth.

figures.title: Connectivity mapping and the SST/PV hypothesis
figures.content: Campagnola et al. 2022 mouse V1 connection probabilities mapped onto the column's type pairs; the Caminos-model wiring; the hypothesis that an SST/PV ratio peaking deep and dipping superficially causes the motif, and the prediction that reversing it reverses the motif (a test with a falsifier, item 17, not a result here).
figures.data_needed: published probability tables; wiring file from item 7

figures.content: The column with HDP adaptation: raster, CSD, LFP, relative power by depth; SST/PV flatten and reverse; top-down and bottom-up baseline-drive ablations that remove the motif.
